# Immutable external OpenRCA source

Original archives are retained in `data/dataset/` without extraction, rewriting or relocation. `data/manifests/openrca.json` is the authoritative source reference and inventory. This directory is a logical mount/reference location, not a second copy.

Do not commit raw telemetry, ZIPs or the deployment workbook. Source version and telemetry licence provenance are not inferred from download filenames; record UNKNOWN until verified. ZIP checksums establish this local snapshot, not completeness against an upstream release.
